# Nautilus Shipping

> Nautilus Shipping is a ship management and marine services company with 19+ years of experience, 200+ ships manned, and a network of 100,000+ seafarers worldwide. The company specializes in crew management and provides complete vessel management and marine services for bulk carriers, container ships, chemical tankers, oil & LPG/LNG tankers, general cargo vessels, and passenger ships. Its "4Ps" approach: Problem-solving with Agility, Performance-based Remuneration, Profit-making for Ship Owners, and Port State Control Adherence. An ISO 9001:2015 certified company, registered under RPSL No: RPSL/CHN/012 (valid to 29-12-2026). Contact: +91 44 4684 9999 | hello@nautilusshipping.com.

## Marine Services

- [Ship Management](https://www.nautilusshipping.com/service/ship-management): Reliable fleet management ensuring safety, efficiency, and compliance, with technical management tailored to each vessel's needs.
- [Crew Management](https://www.nautilusshipping.com/service/crew-management): Expert recruitment, training, and welfare-focused support drawing on a 100,000+ seafarer database.
- [Inspection](https://www.nautilusshipping.com/service/inspection): Thorough vessel inspections upholding safety, performance, and compliance with industry standards.
- [Commercial Services](https://www.nautilusshipping.com/service/commercial-services): Practical commercial solutions to enhance fleet profitability and operational efficiency.
